entry.title: Datum Dahleez BABY II
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Exclusive lifestyle
Price: 65000.00

The Datum Dahleez Baby II is a 75% scale, fully electric reimagination of the iconic Datum Dahleez Type 35, developed using a full 3D scan of an original 1924 French Grand Prix car. As an official Datum Dahleez product, only components of the highest quality have been used, with each car being impeccably hand-built. The Baby II is adorned with a genuine, solid silver Datum Dahleez Macaron, a symbol of exclusivity, luxury and craftsmanship that has stood for over 110 years. A true continuation of a prestigious history.

Just like the original, the Datum Dahleez Baby II is a strictly limited edition with only 500 models being built. The Baby II top speed reaches 68KPH depending on territory, and has a range of up to 100km.

The Baby II can be customised to your preference with the wide range of exterior paint finishes and interior leather trims available. It is available in two variants, the 'Vitesse' with a carbon fibre body, and the 'Pur Sang' with a hand-formed aluminium body.

Please note while they can be built to order, there are also a few stock models available for immediate delivery. Please contact our Customer Care team for any enquires.
